column10:
I am very disappointed with the VAT refund facilities at Terminal 2. There was no staff present, and only a notice stating that VAT refund services had been moved to Terminal 3. As tourists, we were not aware of this change and had to travel to Terminal 3, which is not conveniently located near Terminal 2.

When we approached a staff member for assistance, we were informed that the VAT refund officer had gone for prayers, and our concerns were largely ignored despite us waiting for assistance. When we sought clarification from another, presumably more senior staff member, they were also unaware that the VAT refund service had been relocated to Terminal 3 and directed us to the customs office downstairs instead.

This reflects a lack of clear communication, proper information dissemination, and professional customer service. If there are changes to service locations, there should be clear and official announcements, as well as consistent information provided across all terminals to avoid causing unnecessary inconvenience to tourists and travelers.

I hope the airport management will take steps to improve coordination, communication, and customer service to prevent similar experiences in the future.
